title: Desync/multi-root FSM conformance gaps in Py/Rust: hold-off rejoin unwired, overlap window absent, missed-beacon transition, GUARD_PPM 250 vs 5000, wall_clock/stratum gates, version hooks (spec 02a 2a.5.3/2a.6)
description: Requirements and classifications (Python+Rust; C tracked separately in project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.12/.24): R-02a-040 (overlap = beacons within setup_window+occupied_time+guard window) — window arithmetic absent in all languages, MultiRootState window is caller-scoped (python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:303-357; rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:1033-1103). R-02a-043 (hold-off 3 superframes, then MUST initiate desync+rejoin) — advance_holdoff()==True is only a signal; desync/rejoin not wired to any FSM (py slot_coordination.py:48,359-376; rust multi_instance.rs:840,1108-1122). R-02a-045 (version change resets SFN) — sfn_reset=True flag returned, caller must perform reset. R-02a-079 (MUST match ccp16-desync.json) — only consumer is python/tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py:290-386; no Rust/C consumer. R-02a-081 (transition table) — Python on_missed_superframe early-returns unless RECOVERING so SYNCED->DESYNCED on >=3 missed beacons is unimplemented (python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py:116-119); drift_ppm>GUARD_PPM transition absent in both; Rust DesyncFSM has no missed-superframe tracking at all (rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs:115-149). R-02a-082 (timing params) — GUARD_PPM: spec says 250, every code path and vector (ccp7_holdover.json, ccp16-desync.json excessive_clock_drift_desync, python/src/lichen/timing/ccp7.py:11) uses 5000; Rust lacks TIMEOUT/REJOIN constants. R-02a-084 (MUST NOT leave DESYNCED unless wall_clock_valid=true) — on_beacon(valid: bool) has no wall_clock input (py sfn.py:98; rust desync.rs:128) though the flag exists in all 3. R-02a-085 (stratum ordering gates recovery acceptance) — absent. R-02a-087/088/089 (version-increment hooks during recovery) — absent or sig-only. Suggested placement: extend DesyncFSM in py timing/sfn.py + rust lichen-core/src/desync.rs with missed-superframe SYNCED transition, drift trigger, wall_clock_valid+stratum gates and version hooks; resolve GUARD_PPM 250-vs-5000 in spec or code (spec-internal: 2a.6.3 says 250); wire hold-off completion to desync/rejoin; add ccp16-desync.json consumers for Rust (and C when b7z9.12 lands). From spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (docs/spec-coverage.md R-02a-040..089).
